status: analysis exploration lock; not a model; no version assigned

ticketFeatureSource.win: 95 strict prior-date runner features plus JRA official odds, normalized market probability, strict-OOS normal/value probabilities
ticketFeatureSource.wideAndQuinella: for each of the 95 runner features: pair mean and absolute difference; plus JRA official pair odds, normalized official market probability, strict-OOS normal/value Harville probability and model/market ratios

blendSelector.metric: Bayesian-shrunk realized return of top 10 tickets on strictly prior dates

coldStartFirst30Dates: pre-locked strict-OOS-normal probability times JRA official odds strategy

raceSelection.selector: expanding LightGBM Huber virtual-return regression using prior dates only

allocation: mandatory top ticket 100 yen for win/wide/quinella, then remaining units by chosen-blend ticket score multiplied by prior-date shrunk blend return; maximum 200 yen per ticket
